name: Mock pfSense WAN interface recovery
prompt: Troubleshoot the mock pfSense WAN outage using both shell diagnostics and its layered console menu. Do not disable filtering. Record the evidence, safe action, and menu path in answer.json.

lab.context: pfSense console: 1 Assign Interfaces, 2 Set interface IP, 8 Shell, 11 Restart webConfigurator.

commands.ifconfig igb1:
igb1: flags=8802<BROADCAST,SIMPLEX,MULTICAST> metric 0 mtu 1500
 status: no carrier
commands.netstat -rn:
Destination Gateway Flags Netif
default 192.0.2.1 UGS igb1

menus.8>1>2:
Shell > Interface diagnostics > WAN
WAN maps to igb1; link state down; configured gateway 192.0.2.1
